'''Offworld Trader's''' was a luxury goods shop owned by [[Bengara]] and established in the settlement [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
